notes: Exact math PV(10%,3,0,15000) = 11269.7220 ; the scenario states the inventory fair value / note PV as $11,269, so 11,269 is used as the initial carrying amount and the initial discount is 15,000 - 11,269 = 3,731. Period 3 interest revenue is the plug (15,000 - 13,635.49) so the schedule closes exactly to face. No cash interest is ever received (0% stated rate), so all interest revenue is discount amortization. (e) At Dec 31 Yr1 the note matures Jun 30 Yr4, more than one year (and beyond one operating cycle) after the balance sheet date, so it is reported as a NONCURRENT asset: Note receivable $15,000.00 less unamortized discount $3,167.55 = $11,832.45 net; the discount is a contra-asset shown as a direct deduction, never as a liability, and no portion is current.
